versions.changelog: Notes that sold prices are HM Land Registry records about two months behind; adds rightmove-scraper topic.

Initial release: Access full structured UK Rightmove property data and agent information via Scavio API.

- Search UK property for sale or to rent, with extensive filters (price, bedrooms, property type, features, etc.).
- Retrieve detailed listing info: floorplans, tenure, council tax band, EPC, lease years, and more.
- Get sold house prices with full sale history since 1995, including per-sale price changes.
- Find estate/letting agents in any location, with branch contact details and active listings.
- All data provided as structured JSON through seven easy endpoints; each call costs one credit.
- Requires SCAVIO_API_KEY for access; free tier included (50 credits at signup).
